verdictSummary: No blocking findings. The cutover is complete and correct: the one-time credential reaches each bash command through the bash tool's per-command env, the command text is untouched, the hook's keys are spread last so an imitated env cannot displace the minted grant, GH_TOKEN/GITHUB_TOKEN/GH_HOST are cleared for the command, PATH is rebuilt from the pane's PATH with the worker bin first exactly once, and nothing survives into the next command (verified in the Oh My Pi source: apply_command_env in crates/pi-shell/src/shell.rs pushes an exported Command scope before the command and pops it after). The two regression tests defend the contract; the fixture baseline cannot hide a CI-visible failure; the debug lines carry no secret; the stand-in daemon mirrors CapabilityService.resolveGrant (existence and 60 s expiry, repeat redemption, 403 Invalid or expired grant) and the contract shapes; docs section 1, the changelog, and the pull request description are accurate and name the mechanism. Six non-blocking threads were posted. Not approved yet: the head still carries .legion/.
